intro: A QA engineer resume that shows quality as numbers: bugs caught before release, test time saved, and automation that teams relied on.
tips: Measure quality: escaped bugs, test coverage, release time.
Show automation you built and who used it.
Mention how you work with developers, not just after them.

basics.name: Sofia Lindqvist
basics.label: QA Engineer
basics.summary: QA engineer with five years in test automation for web and mobile apps. I help teams ship faster by making tests fast, reliable and owned by everyone.

work.name: Bokadirekt
highlights: Built the Playwright suite (600 tests) that runs on every pull request in eight minutes.
Cut bugs found in production by 45% in a year by testing earlier, with developers.
Introduced contract tests between the app and 12 backend services.
